S, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE N S SANJAY GOWDA  ORAL ORDER 1.

The prayer in this petition was initially for a direction to be issued to the respondents to consider the representation dated 24.06.2024 by which the petitioner was seeking for allotment of an alternative site to the extent of 11,394 sq.ft. or for payment of compensation under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, year 2013 Act (hereinafter for short referred to as the "2013 Act").
NC: 2025:KHC:945 2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
A memo has been filed by respondent Nos.2 and 3 stating that the said request has been considered and an endorsement has been issued on 25.07.2024.
3.
In light of the endorsement, it is obvious that the prayer in this writ petition would not survive for consideration.
This writ petition is therefore disposed of holding that the petition has become unnecessary, but liberty is reserved to the petitioner to challenge the endorsement dated 25.07.2024, if so advised.
